speaker: judith_sadler
text: The lane has them. We have the bone, and the time a bone takes.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Eat, Will. A mouth can do the rest of this dinner. I am using mine for that.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I am eating. I have finished my speaking for this board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then so have I. The cheese can have what is left of the minute.
